subject.title: Feishu plugin: remove dependency on contact:contact.base:readonly for sender name resolution

question: Should Feishu sender-name and live user-directory lookup become contact-free by default, and what explicit opt-in surface should preserve contact-backed enrichment for deployments that want it?
rationale: The source-supported fix is narrow, but changing a default permission dependency affects security posture, identity attribution, and compatibility for existing Feishu deployments.

options.title: Contact-free default
options.body: Default basic inbound Feishu handling to event/static metadata and stable ids, with documented opt-in for contact-backed enrichment and focused regression tests.

options.title: Keep default with quieter fallback
options.body: Preserve current sender-name lookup by default and only reduce noisy permission notices, leaving the broad contact permission as the recommended path for friendly names.

options.title: Defer to open Feishu PR
options.body: Use the open Feishu display-name PR as the coordination vehicle, but require it to resolve the default-permission decision before this issue can close.

recommendation.title: Contact-free default
recommendation.body: Default basic inbound Feishu handling to event/static metadata and stable ids, with documented opt-in for contact-backed enrichment and focused regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the issue and owns the overlapping open Feishu display-name PR.
